title: StewardMD Disease (knowledge object)
description: Disease KNOWLEDGE only - matching/scoring + reference content. Treatment recommendations live in a SEPARATE Treatment object (treatmentRef). The reasoning engine is generic over this schema: adding a disease is adding one of these files; the engine never changes. Designed to represent every Internal Medicine disease in Harrison without redesign.

id.description: Stable universal disease key, preserved verbatim from the legacy engine (e.g. MENINGITIS infective, dka non-infective) so the engine swap is a drop-in. Never reused.

legacyId.description: Original reasoning.js / SYNDROMES key if it differed; usually == id.

aliases.description: Synonyms / lay terms - also used for retrieval.

system.description: Organ system (free text; mapped to an organ tag by the engine's dzTag).

coding.description: Optional external coding - reserved for interoperability; nullable now.

applicability.description: Optional patient-applicability constraints (future filtering; null = unrestricted).

matching.description: Declarative matching/scoring. Infective diseases use rule+score; non-infective use find. (Both forms are accepted so the two legacy paths unify into one schema.)

rule.description: Boolean match (infective). Mirrors legacy match: e=>...

score.description: Additive base score (infective). Mirrors legacy baseScore: e=>base+Σ

find.description: Weighted finding map (non-infective). Mirrors legacy find:{key:weight}; negative = contradictory.

associatedFindings.description: Findings the soft-score / missing-would-help logic ranges over (≈ engine assocKeys). Defaults to keys in rule/score/find.

reasoningTemplate.description: Human-readable rationale template; replaces the legacy reasoning: e=> closure.

pathogens.description: Infective only. Likely organisms by tier (display/reasoning, not pharmacology).

mimics.description: Conditions that mimic this one (disease ids or text).

narrative.description: RAG-ready knowledge chunks: each is an addressable, individually-citable section (stable id + text + source locator). A future embedding pipeline indexes these; no AI is integrated in this phase.

section.description: Stable chunk id, e.g. overview | pathophysiology | clinical_pearls | pitfalls | mimics_note.

embedding.description: Reserved - populated by the future RAG build step; must be null in authored files.

treatmentRef.description: Id of the SEPARATE Treatment object (usually == id). Knowledge and treatment are kept apart by design.

policyRef.description: Key into hospital PolicyOverlay objects (optional, user-selected).

drugRefs.description: Composition keys (Drug Index) relevant to this disease - links, never copies. The Drug Index stays the only pharmacology DB.

primaryRef.description: Primary disease reference - Harrison's by policy.

contentHash.description: Set by the build step for change detection.

enrichment.description: ADDITIVE reference enrichment, isolated from curated content (never overwrites it). Keyed by source so future re-imports replace only that source's block (idempotent, no duplication). Disease-KNOWLEDGE only - treatment is never sourced here.

harrison.description: Paraphrased Internal-Medicine reference from Harrison 22e (page-cited; not verbatim, for copyright).

conflicts.description: Where Harrison differs from curated content - both kept, attributed.

rule.description: Recursive boolean rule. String = finding key (truthy). Object = combinator or comparison.
